_comment: Expected result of the LLM extraction for two_column_ru.pdf, shaped like app.schemas.llm.ProfileExtraction. MAINTAINED BY HAND — scripts/make_resume_fixtures.py generates the PDF but never touches this file. It is deliberately not exhaustive: the point is a machine-checkable assertion that the narrow sidebar (contacts, skills, languages) did not get interleaved with the wide work-experience column. Every company appears once, with its own dates and is_current flag, and the skills list is complete and in sidebar order — including the near-duplicate pairs Python/Python 3 and Postgres/PostgreSQL, which must survive extraction unmerged and are canonicalised later. Note the deliberate overlap: the freelance role at Студия «Пиксель-Мираж» (2021-06..2023-12) runs across both ТОО «Вымпел-Софт» and ООО «Орбита-Технологии», so summing durations overstates the total; the union is 2018-04..today. Tests must strip this _comment before validating, because ProfileExtraction forbids extra fields.
